name: barbell front squat (from blocks)
description: A front squat started from a rack or blocks height, so you begin the rep with the bar already set. It builds quad and trunk strength.
instructions: Set the bar on the blocks or rack at front shoulder height.
Step in, rest the bar on your front shoulders with elbows high.
Lift it off and stand tall with feet shoulder width apart.
Squat down with a tall chest until your thighs pass parallel.
Stand back up by driving through your feet, then re-rack the bar.
